arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Shanmugam argued that enforcing security interests is not debt collection.
Mr. Geyser argued that non-judicial foreclosures are direct debt collection attempts.
Mr. Bond argued that Congress limited debt collector status to one subsection.
Mr. Geyser argued that the statute targets actions to enforce real property interests.
